stories.title: Houthis advance toward Aden after Yemen forces quit Bab el-Mandeb
stories.summary: Yemeni government forces withdrew from the Bab el-Mandeb area to reinforce Aden, leaving the Iran-aligned Houthis in control of the key Red Sea chokepoint. The pullback ends a six-week, Saudi-backed campaign to retake the coast.

stories.title: China calls Xi-Putin-Trump meeting 'groundbreaking'
stories.summary: China's foreign ministry said this week's Xi-Putin-Trump meeting in Shenzhen has 'groundbreaking significance' and will promote world peace and stability. The Thursday trilateral on the APEC sidelines would be the first face-to-face meeting of the three leaders.

stories.title: ASEAN and China fail to agree on South China Sea code
stories.summary: ASEAN and China ended their Manila talks without agreeing on a South China Sea code of conduct, with the Philippines' envoy saying 'there is no conclusion yet.' Whether the code would be legally binding remains among the unresolved issues.

stories.title: Eisenkot says Netanyahu can't remain Israel PM amid vote-meddling claims
stories.summary: Israeli opposition leader Gadi Eisenkot said Benjamin Netanyahu cannot remain prime minister amid alleged meddling in Israel's 2026 election. The claim escalates the political crisis over the integrity of the vote.

stories.title: Senator slams Commerce Dept for flow of Nvidia AI chips to China
stories.summary: Sen. Maria Cantwell accused the Commerce Department of letting advanced Nvidia AI chips reach China, saying it 'undermined America's national security.' In a letter to Secretary Howard Lutnick, she cited warnings about Megaspeed and other pathways used to divert chips ahead of this week's Xi meeting.

stories.title: Alibaba launches Qwen4-Max flagship AI model
stories.summary: Alibaba launched Qwen4-Max, a 2.4-trillion-parameter flagship model it says tops several coding benchmarks while cutting task costs about 60% versus its predecessor. Unlike earlier Qwen releases, its weights are closed.

stories.title: VC firm Plural raises $1.1B to back Europe's next 'moonshots'
stories.summary: Operator-led VC firm Plural raised 1 billion euros ($1.1B) for its third fund, with two-thirds for early-stage investments and the rest for follow-ons. An early Helsing backer, it will target energy, AI infrastructure, defense and health.

stories.title: Apple launches app to study how people use AI for health
stories.summary: Apple launched the Apple Health AI Usage Study, a US research app built with OpenEvidence to study how people use conversational AI for health questions. It will examine trust, response quality and everyday health actions.

stories.title: Browns beat Texans 27-24, head to bye at 6-4
stories.summary: The Browns improved to 6-4 with a 27-24 comeback win over the Texans, already surpassing their preseason win-total projection. Cleveland erased a 17-0 deficit behind Deshaun Watson and a defense that shut down C.J. Stroud after halftime.

stories.title: No. 17 Ohio State women rout Fairleigh Dickinson 93-49
stories.summary: Freshmen Diaz and Mobley led No. 17 Ohio State women's basketball to a 93-49 win over Fairleigh Dickinson.

stories.title: Ohio State moves up in Coaches Poll after Northwestern win
stories.summary: Ohio State moved up in the Week 11 Coaches Poll after snapping a two-game skid with a 28-19 win over Northwestern. The Buckeyes sit on the College Football Playoff bubble with two regular-season games left.

stories.title: Kickoff time set for Ohio State's trip to Nebraska
stories.summary: Kickoff time is set for Ohio State's Nov. 21 game at Nebraska, the first of two must-win games for the Buckeyes' fading College Football Playoff hopes.

stories.title: McLaren determined to take P3 fight 'down to the wire'
stories.summary: McLaren racing director Randy Singh said the team is determined to take its fight for third in the constructors' championship down to the wire. McLaren trails Red Bull by 17 points entering the final Las Vegas, Qatar and Abu Dhabi rounds.

stories.title: Haas keeps Camara for Las Vegas GP, Hirakawa in for FP1
stories.summary: Haas confirmed rookie Rafael Camara will race again at the Las Vegas Grand Prix, with Ryo Hirakawa taking the car for FP1. Camara made his F1 debut in Brazil as Haas battles Audi for seventh in the constructors' standings.

stories.title: What is left to fight for in F1 2026?
stories.summary: With both 2026 titles decided, Autosport breaks down what's still at stake over the final three races — a five-driver fight for second behind champion Kimi Antonelli and Red Bull vs McLaren for third in the constructors'.

stories.title: One injured in attempted robbery on Ohio State campus
stories.summary: One person was injured in an attempted robbery on the Ohio State campus, Columbus police said. OSU police said safety is a priority as the investigation continues.

stories.title: One dead in south Columbus shooting
stories.summary: One person is dead following a shooting in south Columbus, police said Monday morning.
